info.title: Smart Publisher API
info.description: Multi-tenant social publishing platform API. Every JSON response is wrapped in the envelope described by ApiEnvelope: {success, message, data, meta, errors}. Authenticate with a Laravel Sanctum bearer token obtained from POST /auth/login, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every subsequent request. Endpoints under /organization/* and most tenant-scoped resources additionally require an active organization context, selected via POST /organizations/{organization}/switch or the X-Organization-Id header where noted.
